next:or:233.hint: 2つのものを対等に否定する比較構文
next:or:233.question: A whale is [[no less a fish than]] a horse is.
next:or:233.fullSentence: A whale is no more a fish than a horse is.
next:or:233.explanation: no more A than B(通称クジラ構文)。
next:or:233.relatedInfo: BはAでないことが明白な例を使って否定を強調する。

next:or:234.hint: 犬が哺乳類であるのと同様、コウモリも哺乳類だ
next:or:234.fullSentence: A bat is no less a mammal than a dog is.
next:or:234.explanation: no less A than B。クジラ構文の逆で、両方とも同程度に肯定される。
next:or:234.relatedInfo: no more A than B(否定)との対比。

next:or:235.hint: BができないのとAも同様にできないことを表す比較表現
next:or:235.question: Chimpanzees [[can no less speak than]] dogs can.
next:or:235.fullSentence: Chimpanzees can no more speak than dogs can.
next:or:235.explanation: not A any more than B『Bと同様Aも〜ない』。no more...thanの形。

next:or:236.hint: 幸せな結婚にはお金も愛と同様に必要だ
next:or:236.fullSentence: Money is no less necessary for a happy marriage than love is.
next:or:236.relatedInfo: no more...than(否定)の逆で肯定的な同等比較。

next:or:237.hint: 多くても、という上限を表す表現
next:or:237.question: I have [[not less than]] five dollars.
next:or:237.fullSentence: I have not more than five dollars.
next:or:237.explanation: not more than = at most『多くても』。
next:or:237.relatedInfo: not less than(少なくとも)との対比。

next:or:238.fullSentence: I have not less than five dollars.
next:or:238.explanation: not less than = at least『少なくとも』。
next:or:238.relatedInfo: not more than(多くても)との対比。

next:or:239.hint: 少なさを強調する表現
next:or:239.question: I have [[no less than]] five dollars.
next:or:239.fullSentence: I have no more than five dollars.
next:or:239.explanation: no more than = only『たった〜しか』。
next:or:239.relatedInfo: not more than(せいぜい、意味が中立)とのニュアンスの違いに注意。

next:or:240.fullSentence: I have no less than five dollars.
next:or:240.explanation: no less than = as much/many as『〜も』。
next:or:240.relatedInfo: 多さを強調するニュアンス。

next:or:241.hint: 単数の集合名詞を比較対象にした最上級
next:or:241.question: John is [[the smartest of]] his family.
next:or:241.fullSentence: John is the smartest in his family.
next:or:241.relatedInfo: of+複数(比較対象の集団)との使い分け。

next:or:242.hint: 彼はその3人の少年の中で一番速く走れる
next:or:242.fullSentence: He can run the fastest of the three boys.
next:or:242.explanation: the+最上級+of+複数(比較対象の集団)。
next:or:242.relatedInfo: in+単数集合名詞との使い分け。

next:or:243.hint: 経験を根拠にした最上級構文
next:or:243.question: She is [[the most intelligent woman what I know]].
next:or:243.answer: the most intelligent woman that I know
next:or:243.fullSentence: She is the most intelligent woman that I know.
next:or:243.wrongPart: the most intelligent woman what I know
next:or:243.explanation: 最上級+that S have (ever) pp の構文の基本形。
next:or:243.relatedInfo: that節にはeverを伴うこともある。

next:or:244.hint: その映画は断然すべての中で一番面白い
next:or:244.fullSentence: The movie is by far the most interesting of all.
next:or:244.explanation: 最上級の強調はby far, much, far, very, the veryを使う。
next:or:244.relatedInfo: by farは最上級を強調する代表的な語句。

next:or:245.hint: 最上級+複数名詞で『最も〜な…の1つ』を表す形
next:or:245.question: This is [[one of the greatest invention]] ever.
next:or:245.fullSentence: This is one of the greatest inventions ever.
next:or:245.explanation: one of the+最上級+複数名詞『最も〜な…の1つ』。
next:or:245.relatedInfo: 最上級の後の名詞は複数形にする。

next:or:246.hint: 私はせいぜいかばんを3つしか運べない
next:or:246.fullSentence: I can carry at most three bags.
next:or:246.explanation: at most=多くても(=not more than)。
next:or:246.relatedInfo: at least(少なくとも)との対比。

next:or:247.hint: 序数を使った最上級表現
next:or:247.question: This is [[the third large]] city in Japan.
next:or:247.fullSentence: This is the third largest city in Japan.
next:or:247.explanation: the+序数+最上級『〜番目に最も…』。
next:or:247.relatedInfo: the second, the thirdなど序数を最上級の前に置く。

next:or:248.hint: 今朝はコーヒーよりむしろ紅茶が飲みたい
next:or:248.fullSentence: I'd like tea rather than coffee this morning.
next:or:248.explanation: rather than A『Aよりむしろ』。比較級を用いた慣用表現。
next:or:248.relatedInfo: B rather than A『AよりむしろB』の形でよく使う。

next:or:249.hint: 分別があってそんなことはしない、を表す比較表現
next:or:249.question: He should [[know well than to do]] such a thing.
next:or:249.fullSentence: He should know better than to do such a thing.
next:or:249.explanation: know better than to do『〜するほど馬鹿ではない』。
next:or:249.relatedInfo: 分別があるので〜しない、というニュアンス。

next:or:250.hint: 彼は彼女を信用するほど馬鹿ではなかったはずなのに
next:or:250.fullSentence: He should have known better than to trust her.
next:or:250.explanation: should have known better than to do『〜するほど馬鹿ではなかったのに(実際はしてしまった)』。
next:or:250.relatedInfo: know better than to doの過去の後悔形。

next:or:251.hint: 否定文の後に続けて『まして〜ない』を表す表現
next:or:251.question: I can't even swim, [[much more]] dive.
next:or:251.fullSentence: I can't even swim, much less dive.
next:or:251.explanation: much less〜『まして〜ない』(否定文の後で使う)。
next:or:251.relatedInfo: still lessも同じ意味で使われる。

next:or:252.hint: この車は燃費であの車より優れている
next:or:252.fullSentence: This car is superior to that one in fuel efficiency.
next:or:252.explanation: be superior to B『Bより優れている』。比較対象にthanでなくtoを使う形容詞群の一つ。
next:or:252.relatedInfo: be inferior to B(劣っている)がその反対。

next:or:253.hint: 年齢の上で先輩であることを表す形容詞
next:or:253.question: He is [[senior than me]] by two years.
next:or:253.fullSentence: He is senior to me by two years.
next:or:253.explanation: be senior to B『Bより年上だ、先輩だ』。
next:or:253.relatedInfo: be junior to B(年下、後輩)がその反対。

next:or:254.hint: 彼女は会社で彼より後輩だ
next:or:254.fullSentence: She is junior to him in the company.
next:or:254.explanation: be junior to B『Bより年下だ、後輩だ』。
next:or:254.relatedInfo: be senior to B(先輩)がその反対。

next:or:255.hint: 質が劣っていることを表す形容詞
next:or:255.question: This plan is [[inferior than]] the original one.
next:or:255.fullSentence: This plan is inferior to the original one.
next:or:255.explanation: be inferior to B『Bより劣っている』。
next:or:255.relatedInfo: be superior to B(優れている)がその反対。

next:or:256.hint: 私は紅茶よりコーヒーの方が好きだ
next:or:256.explanation: prefer A to B『BよりAを好む』。
next:or:256.relatedInfo: than ではなくtoを使う点に注意。

next:or:257.hint: 『〜することはできない』を表す動名詞の慣用構文
next:or:257.question: [[There is no tell]] what will happen next.
next:or:257.fullSentence: There is no telling what will happen next.
next:or:257.explanation: There is no doing『〜することはできない』。
next:or:257.relatedInfo: There is no knowing/sayingなどもよく使われる。
